text: P03 plan: (1) h03-1 src/solve/proposer.ts: run the proposer command in the problem folder, write the stdin object {round,goal,files,history,candidates}, parse stdout {proposals:[{summary,edits}]}. Bad JSON, bad shape, non-zero exit or timeout -> a failed-proposal result with a plain reason, never a throw. Empty list -> 'nothing more to try'. (2) h04-1 edits.ts: search must occur exactly once, else a failed attempt with a reason. (3) Wire into loop.ts with h05: failures go into history and result.json attempts. Tests: test/solve-proposer.test.ts with fake proposer scripts.
P03 verdict: medium-small. Protocol is simple; the risk is integration with loop.ts and history (P12). Check file not yet published.
